title: Gca Bay Area Ras Garba - Oct 16th By Sheth & Joshipura Team - Alap Group
description: Immerse in the Vibrant Night of GCA Bay Area Ras Garba

long_description:
Immerse in the Vibrant Night of GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
Prepare to be swept off your feet at the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba on the 16th of October, 2026. Presented by the dynamic Sheth & Joshipura Team from Alap Group, this event promises an unforgettable evening of resounding beats, graceful twirls, and heartwarming camaraderie. Revel in the rich Gujarati culture and the multilingual music as we celebrate the auspicious Navratri/Dandiya season. Mark your calendars, because this is one event you wouldn't want to miss!
The Artistic Masters Behind The Scene
While the artist for this event remains a delightful surprise, be assured that the Sheth & Joshipura Team from Alap Group has a reputation for roping in the most talented performers. Known for their discerning taste and high standards, they have consistently delivered events that strike the perfect balance of tradition and innovation. Stay tuned to experience the magic they bring to the stage this year.
Experience the Event at the Historic Washington High School
Set in the beautiful city of Fremont, CA, United States, the event will take place in the iconic Washington High School located at 38442 Boulevard. Known for its safety, accessibility, and the tranquil ambiance, the venue enhances the overall event experience. Parking is readily available, and for those looking to grab a bite before or after the event, there are numerous Indian restaurants in the vicinity.
Secure Your Spot: Ticket Information
Experience the magic of GCA Bay Area Ras Garba by securing your tickets today. For General Admission, tickets are reasonably priced at $25.00. If you're planning to come in a group of 8 or more, take advantage of our group offer at just $23.00 per ticket. Don't miss out on the chance to be part of this vibrant celebration. Reserve your spot now!
